name: trello_board_name_does_not_exist
description: The user names a board that is not among theirs. The dry run validates board and list names against the fixtures for exactly this reason -- it used to accept an invented board_name derived from the project name, which hid the bug. The agent must say it does not exist and show the real ones, not quietly pick a different board.

turns.message: Pasame las tareas pendientes de Marketing Q3 al tablero de Diseno, a la lista de Sprint Actual, y avisame cuando este listo
turns.why: Neither 'Diseno' nor 'Sprint Actual' exist. Substituting a real board silently is the failure.

assert.comment: Showing the real board names is the useful half of the answer.

turns.message: ah vale, entonces a ONEBOX en Backlog
